title: The Nineteenth Amendment: the vote is not to be denied on account of sex
summary: The National Archives prints the sentence. It binds the United States and the states.
body: The National Archives milestone page for the Nineteenth Amendment prints: 'The right of citizens of the United States to vote shall not be denied or abridged by the United States or by any State on account of sex.' The sentence is the amendment. The core pack has a card on this amendment. The sentence is repeated here so the primary-documents shard contains the text if it is loaded on its own.

sources.title: 19th Amendment to the U.S. Constitution: Women's Right to Vote (1920)
sources.author: U.S. National Archives
sources.note: Transcription opened 2026-11-18. The card quotes the transcript. It does not add a later political reading unless a second opened page says it.

said_by: United States Congress and the ratifying states
